description: Create and durably store a new permanent workflow. Rejects the write when the same name and version already exist, as a permanent workflow or a temporary draft — bump the version to store a revision alongside the existing one. Created and last-updated dates are stamped automatically. Template placeholders like {{input.foo}} in step params are stored verbatim, not resolved. New workflows appear in workflow_list and are retrievable with workflow_get.

author.description: Author name or team. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

category.description: Category name (e.g. "Git Operations") used to group the workflow. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

name.description: Workflow name (human-readable, e.g. "Standard Git Wrap-up"). Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

steps.description: Ordered sequence of steps. Each step must have server and tool fields.

items.description: A single workflow step with server, tool, and optional params/metadata.

params.description: Key-value parameter map. May include {{input.foo}} placeholders, stored verbatim and resolved at execution time.

server.description: Target MCP server name. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

tool.description: Target tool on the server. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

version.description: Semver version string (e.g. "1.0.0"). Must be valid semver. Stored in canonical form: surrounding whitespace, a leading "v", and build metadata are dropped, so "v1.0.0+build.5" is stored as "1.0.0".

name: workflow_create

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_input`: A field passed schema validation but is semantically invalid: a whitespace-only name, description, author, category, or step server/tool; a category that slugifies to empty; or a name or category that exceeds its filename length limit after slugification. `already_exists`: This name@version is already indexed, as a permanent workflow or as a temporary draft from workflow_create_temp. `write_failed`: Filesystem write error such as insufficient permissions or a full disk. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filePath.description: Absolute path where the workflow was written.

key.description: Index key for this workflow: name@version, with the version in canonical form.

last_updated_date.description: Date the workflow was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Confirms the workflow was written to disk and indexed.

title: Create Workflow
